pdf.js — Mozilla PDF rendering library
======================================

Version: 3.11.174
Source:  https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/
License: Apache-2.0  (https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/LICENSE)

Used by:
  src/main/resources/templates/task-view.html
    — inline SOP PDF rendering + scroll-to-bottom gate on Start Task button.

To upgrade:
  1. Pick a new version from https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases
     (any 3.x release is API-compatible; 4.x+ requires ES module loading)
  2. Replace these two files:
        pdf.min.js
        pdf.worker.min.js
     from https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/<version>/
  3. Update the version recorded above.

Files are served by Spring Boot's default static handler at:
  /vendor/pdfjs/pdf.min.js
  /vendor/pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.js
